hooks.command:
INPUT=$(cat)
V=$(awk 'NF{print $NF; exit}' "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/VERSION" 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$V" ] || V=dev
if command -v solana >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  RPC=$(solana config get json_rpc_url 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $NF}' | sed -E 's#^([a-z]+://[^/?]+).*#\1#')
  WALLET=$(solana address 2>/dev/null) || WALLET='none configured'
  CTX="Solana CLI: RPC ${RPC:-unknown}, wallet ${WALLET:-none configured}."
else
  CTX='Solana CLI not found on PATH.'
fi
case $INPUT in *'"startup"'*) ;; *) printf '%s\n' "$CTX"; exit 0 ;; esac
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s\n' "$CTX"; exit 0; }
BANNER=$(printf '%s\n' \
  '   _____ ____  __    ___    _   _____' \
  '  / ___// __ \/ /   /   |  / | / /   |' \
  '  \__ \/ / / / /   / /| | /  |/ / /| |' \
  ' ___/ / /_/ / /___/ ___ |/ /|  / ___ |' \
  '/____/\____/_____/_/  |_/_/ |_/_/  |_|' \
  '           ▄▀█ █   █▄▀ █ ▀█▀' \
  '           █▀█ █   █ █ █  █' \
  "     v$V — by @SuperteamBR 🇧🇷")
jq -n --arg b "$BANNER" --arg c "$CTX" '{systemMessage: $b, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: $c}}'
